name: atlas-forge
description: Oficina independente de mundos esféricos do Ecosystem, local e offline

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/terrain-browser.mjs && node tests/zoom-browser.mjs && node tests/ecosystem-browser.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: prettier --write src/rendering/landmarks.js tests/landmarks.test.mjs && mkdir -p test-results/format && cp src/rendering/landmarks.js tests/landmarks.test.mjs test-results/format/ && prettier --check src scripts tests index.html package.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests index.html package.json
